lead: Use case: stylized-concept. Production character atlas for a vertical scrolling life-story graphic novel game. EXACT grid TWO columns by SEVEN rows, every cell equal size. One isolated WAIST-UP portrait in each cell, ample clear transparent margin, no text, labels, grid or scenery. Same male protagonist aging through seven rows: row1 one year old baby with mustard bib; row2 five year old in ochre sweater; row3 eleven year old in muted teal school uniform; row4 seventeen year old in black jacket with gray hood and thin rectangular spectacles; row5 twenty-eight year old with short untidy black hair, rectangular black-rim spectacles, black jacket gray hood and cream shirt; row6 fifty year old with gray temples, navy cardigan, spectacles; row7 seventy-five year old with silver hair, brown cardigan, spectacles. Column1 calm thoughtful face looking three-quarter left; column2 the SAME age and exact costume with concerned determined face, hand raised near chest. Adult faces narrow and realistically proportioned, small restrained eyes and subtle nose and mouth, shoulders broad, distinct grown adult anatomy. NO chibi, NO doll proportions, NO oversized anime eyes. Style: Urban Myth Dissolution Center inspired urban mystery visual novel pixel illustration; deliberate chunky stepped pixels, hard edges, flat graphic shadows, dark ink outlines, restrained five-tone palette of near-black blue, dark teal, pale teal, ivory skin, very sparing oxblood red. Crisp graphic print quality, mature psychological manga tone, no gradients, no smooth painting. All fourteen figures fully inside cells. Genuine transparent alpha background.
npc: Use case: stylized-concept. Production NPC atlas for a mature urban-mystery vertical graphic novel life-simulation. EXACT TWO columns x SIX rows of equal cells, one isolated waist-up human portrait each cell with generous genuinely transparent margins, no text, no grid, no background. Each row same person repeated two expressions: column1 thoughtful calm, column2 worried or speaking with hand near chest. Rows: caring middle-aged mother with tied dark hair and plum cardigan; adult male friend in teal casual jacket; female teacher with shoulder-length straight hair, glasses and blue blouse; middle-aged male boss in dark suit and red tie; adult female partner with short bob, sage cardigan; elderly male neighbor with silver hair and beige vest. Human adult anatomy, narrow expressive faces, small restrained eyes, broad enough shoulders, waist-up framing, no chibi, no doll shapes, no huge anime eyes. Original cast with consistent Urban Myth Dissolution Center inspired flat pixel graphic style, crisp intentionally chunky square pixels and dark outlines, mature psychological mystery tone. Very limited palette: near black ink blue, dark petrol teal, pale teal, ivory skin, sparse oxblood-red highlights. Flat sharp two-tone shadow blocks, no gradients, no painterly smoothing, no scenery. Every figure entirely within its regular cell.
